--- type: Block title: Page, Stack description: "Page is a page's box for an app without AppShell: a gutter, a widest width and even space between its sections." resource: https://lede.cloudcompute.com/r/v0.7.2/page.json tags: - block - page stability: experimental lede_version: 0.7.2 --- # Page, Stack > Lede 0.7.2's docs for Page, Stack, installed with it. Setup, and every item in the release: [README.md](README.md). Online: https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/page.md Page is a page's box for an app without AppShell: a gutter, a widest width and even space between its sections. Stack puts its children one under another with one gap between each. Experimental: its props can change in a minor release, which the CHANGELOG names. An item is experimental for the release that adds it, and stable once a release ships it unchanged. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @lede/page @lede/page-header @lede/list ``` The command needs Lede's registry in `components.json`, as [README.md](README.md#use-it-in-a-shadcn-project) shows. It also installs the items [`lede-theme`](lede-theme.md) and [`lede-utils`](lede-utils.md), and the npm packages `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`. It adds [`page-header`](https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/page-header.md) and [`list`](https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/list.md) only because the example below imports them. The item's JSON, with each file's source, is https://lede.cloudcompute.com/r/v0.7.2/page.json. ## Import ```tsx import { Page, Stack } from '@/components/lede/blocks/page'; ``` ## Files and exports | Installs to | Import from | Exports | | --- | --- | --- | | `components/lede/blocks/page.tsx` | `@/components/lede/blocks/page` | `Page` (component), `Stack` (component), `PageProps` (type), `StackProps` (type) | ## Page props A page’s box for an app without AppShell: a gutter, a widest width and the space between its sections, a PageHeader first.
